title: Stellamore T950S projector (Droidlogic be30a3, ro.product.devicetype=T950S, Amlogic txhd2)
header:
Stellamore T950S projector (Droidlogic be30a3, ro.product.devicetype=T950S, Amlogic txhd2)
Android 13 (API 33, armeabi-v7a). Firmware fingerprint:
Android/r34a1/r34a1:5.1.1/LMY47V/20220912:userdebug/test-keys
ro.stellamore.devicetype=STM930M8001_HTP_A3_WZATCO
~1 GB RAM. Sold as a "4K" projector box; usually arrives with a third-party launcher
(com.overdevs.at4k) already set as Home and the stock Zeasn launcher already disabled.

Apply:  TV_HOST=<ip> tools/disable.sh examples/stellamore-t950s/debloat.txt
Undo:   TV_HOST=<ip> tools/restore.sh examples/stellamore-t950s/debloat.txt com.zeasn.whale.saas
Everything is disabled with `pm disable-user`, never uninstalled. Tested 2026-10-19.

Device-specific names:
stock launcher : com.zeasn.whale.saas            (pass it to restore.sh / build-and-install)
Live TV app    : com.droidlogic.android.tv
keystone/geometry: com.droidlogic.keystone       <-- KEEP, disabling breaks the projected image
sideload tile  : com.droidlogic.appinstall ("AppInsta..."), File Manager: com.stellamore.filemanager
com.hysd.client + com.hysd.hyscreen (hysd.cn "HYSDVAFocus") are a voice/focus pair and are LEFT ON.

Adware found here: both the Zeasn "App Store" (TvStore_zeasn) and the stock Zeasn launcher
(TvLauncher_zeasn) bundle Google's Ads/AdMob SDK (com/google/ads/*) and call
googleads.g.doubleclick.net, ad.doubleclick.net and dai.google.com. Both are priv-apps that ask
for SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW + INSTALL_PACKAGES and register a BOOT_COMPLETED receiver.

apps.note: "App Store" home tile - ships Google Ads (doubleclick)

optional.note: stock launcher - also ships Google Ads (doubleclick).
